'''Kursid''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was inhabited by a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified Kursid species|primitive]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] whose sole contact with the greater galaxy was through [[Sith training|training]] missions conducted to the planet by the [[Order of the Sith Lords]].

==History==
At some point many centuries before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the world's location was deleted from the Republic records; starting around [[654 BBY]], it was frequently visited by members of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], who knew it as "Kursid." On the occasions of their visits, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sought battle with the Kursid natives in an arid plateau on the part of the planet where they landed, and engaged large numbers of them in combat in order to hone their skills. Despite the hostile intentions of the Sith, a [[Kursid Sith cult|cult]] centered on the periodic returns of the sky visitors eventually developed on that part of the planet.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] traveled to Kursid with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], c. [[104 BBY/Legends|104 BBY]]; approximately [[54 BBY/Legends|fifty years later]], Plagueis, now a [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], journeyed to the world with his own apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kursid first appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
